data.summary:
* Reviewed PR #1920 which refactors 4,786-line `codeRoutes.ts` into a 41-line thin plugin composing 5 resource-specific sub-plugins — structural decomposition is excellent, CI is fully green.
  * 🔴 `/code/cancel` handler (task-routes.ts:2384–2459, ~75 lines) violates Requirement #4 ("no business logic in route handlers") and the >5-lines rule; needs a `cancelTask` use case extracting ownership verification, status guard, and worker-credential lookup.
  * 🔴 The spec's "Test Requirements (MANDATORY)" table (6 behavioral scenarios) is absent from all 5 new per-plugin test files — they only check URL registration, not handler behavior.
  * ⚠️ `queue-routes.ts` branch coverage at 94.73%; `split-sanity.test.ts` missing `resetServices()` in `afterEach`.
  * Both 🔴 findings require code remediation before this PR meets the Definition of Done.
